services.name: 4 Hour SHARE Kauai Sportfishing Tour
services.desc: Join us on a public fishing charter to share a fun experience with likeminded anglers in Kauai. All equipment is provided for your convenience. Important Information Our fishing vessel the "Pi'ikea' can take a maximum of 6 people. Our SHARE tour, we require a minimum of 4 people to confirm the tour. You are welcome to pay for the additional space to confirm a trip. Once on board we'll give a short safety briefing and get on our way. Time for the tour starts once we leave the dock. About Typically, we'll begin setting the lines in the water as we are exiting the outer break wall and officially declare the fishing has started! services.name: 4 Hour PRIVATE Kauai Sportfishing Tour
services.desc: Our PRIVATE tour, is just that. We close the boat to other groups and keep it to just your group! Get your group together and reserve the boat today! Important Information Our fishing vessel the "Pi'ikea' can take a maximum of 6 people. Once on board we'll give a short safety briefing and get on our way. Time for the tour starts once we leave the dock. About Typically we'll begin setting the lines in the water as we are exiting the outer break wall and officially declare the fishing has started!
